caption:
True or False? 🤔

"Paying only the minimum on a credit card is fine as long as you never miss a payment."

Tell us what you think, then check the answer in the comments.
first_comment: Answer: False. You avoid a late fee, but interest keeps building on the balance, so the debt can last years. Paying more than the minimum cuts that down. Did you get it right? 👇

instagram.first_comment: True or false? Answer in the comments at @paychecktruths 👇
